# technitium_group (Resource)

Manages a user group. Assign users with `technitium_user.groups`; grant access with `technitium_permission`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_group" "dns_ops" {
  name        = "dns-ops"
  description = "Can edit zones"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name. Changing it renames the group in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Group description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group name.
- `members` (Set of String) Usernames in the group (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_group.dns_ops dns-ops
```
